description: Wild shape uses/day by character level — this campaign scales wild shape with character level, not standard druid class level (CLAUDE.md > Class Progression: 'Scales with CHARACTER level'). DM-confirmed full curve (Aug 2026): 1/day at 5, 2/day at 6, 3/day at 7 (holds through 8-9), 4/day at 10 (holds through 11-13), 5/day at 14 (holds through 15-17), 6/day at 18 (holds through 19-20). The level-up flow still shows this as an editable suggestion pre-filled from this table rather than applying it silently, in case a future houserule changes it.
